description: Add an admin EDIT capability for an existing short link's custom OG image/title (BUG #2). Today api-node/src/routes/admin-links.ts has GET (list) + POST (create) only, and web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx can only create — there is no way to edit an existing link's og_image/og_title. Add: a service updateCustomShortLink(code, {ogImage, ogTitle}) reusing the EXISTING normaliseOgImage/normaliseOgTitle validators; a staff-gated PATCH /api/admin/links/:code route; a web client updateShortLink(); and an inline Edit UI per row that pre-fills and saves og_image/og_title and renders the current values. Edit is scoped to og_image/og_title only (the fields BUG #2 names); target_url/type stay immutable to preserve all existing redirects on this LIVE app. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared files except that both touch short-link OG handling in separate functions).
steps: In api-node/src/services/shortLink.ts add `export async function updateCustomShortLink(code: string, input: { ogImage?: string | null; ogTitle?: string | null }): Promise<CreateCustomShortLinkResult>`: validate code with the same `/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$/` rule (throw a clear Error on a bad code); compute `const og_image = normaliseOgImage(input.ogImage); const og_title = normaliseOgTitle(input.ogTitle);` (REUSE the existing validators — do not reimplement); verify the row exists via `prisma.shortLink.findUnique({ where: { code }, select: { target_url: true, type: true } })` and if missing throw a distinct not-found Error (e.g. a new `ShortLinkNotFoundError` class, mirroring ShortCodeTakenError) so the route can map it to 404; then `await prisma.shortLink.update({ where: { code }, data: { og_image, og_title } });` and return `{ code, target_url: row.target_url, type: row.type, og_image, og_title }` (the CreateCustomShortLinkResult shape).

In api-node/src/routes/admin-links.ts add an `updateSchema = z.object({ ogImage: z.string().max(1000).optional(), ogTitle: z.string().max(255).optional() })` and a `router.patch('/:code', ...)` handler (the file already applies `router.use(requireAuth, requireStaff('ads'))`, so it inherits the guard). On parse failure `return fail(res, 'Invalid preview fields', 422)`. In a try/catch mirroring the POST handler: call `const link = await updateCustomShortLink(req.params.code, parsed.data);` → `return ok(res, { message: 'Short link updated', link });`. Map the not-found error to `fail(res, msg, 404)` and other Errors (e.g. the http(s) image rule) to `fail(res, msg, 422)`. Import updateCustomShortLink (and the not-found error class) from '../services/shortLink'.

In web/src/lib/admin.ts add, in the Short Links section beside createShortLink: `export async function updateShortLink(code: string, input: { ogImage?: string; ogTitle?: string }) { return (await api.patch(`/admin/links/${code}`, input)).data; }`.

In web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx: (a) render the current og_image/og_title in the list — e.g. add a 'Preview / प्रीव्यू' column showing a small of l.og_image (when set) or a '4A Store logo (default)' muted label when empty, plus the l.og_title or a muted em-dash; (b) add an '✏️ Edit / संपादित करें' btnGhost button per row; (c) track editing state (e.g. `const [editCode, setEditCode] = useState(null)` plus editImage/editTitle inputs) and when editing a row render an inline editor using the existing inp/lbl/btnPrimary/btnGhost style tokens, pre-filled with that row's og_image/og_title; (d) a Save handler that calls `updateShortLink(code, { ogImage: editImage.trim(), ogTitle: editTitle.trim() })`, then `await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['admin-links'] })`, `showToast('✅ Updated / अपडेट हो gaya', 'success')`, and clears edit state; on error `showToast(apiError(err) || 'Could not update', 'error')`; and a Cancel that clears edit state. Match the bilingual English+Hindi label style already in the file. Update the table header colSpan on the empty-state row if the column count changes.
acceptance_criteria: api-node/src/services/shortLink.ts exports updateCustomShortLink that reuses normaliseOgImage/normaliseOgTitle and throws a distinct not-found error for an unknown code.
PATCH /api/admin/links/:code is staff-gated (requireAuth + requireStaff('ads')), returns the ok() envelope with the updated link on success, 404 for an unknown code, and 422 for an invalid image URL.
web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx shows each link's current og_image/og_title and an Edit button that opens an inline editor which saves via updateShortLink and refreshes the list.
`cd api-node && npm test` stays fully green and both builds compile.
verification: cd api-node && npm run build  (tsc clean)
cd api-node && npm test  (all tests pass)
cd web && npm run build  (Vite build clean)
findings: Implemented the admin EDIT capability for a short link's custom OG image/title. - api-node/src/services/shortLink.ts: added `updateCustomShortLink(code, { ogImage, ogTitle })` REUSING the existing normaliseOgImage/normaliseOgTitle validators (no reimplementation), plus a new `ShortLinkNotFoundError` (mirrors ShortCodeTakenError) for a missing code. Validates the code with the same `/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}$/` rule, validates the OG overrides BEFORE any DB access, verifies the row via findUnique(select target_url,type), then prisma.shortLink.update of og_image/og_title only. target_url/type stay immutable; returns the CreateCustomShortLinkResult shape. - api-node/src/routes/admin-links.ts: added `updateSchema` (ogImage max1000 / ogTitle max255, both optional) and `router.patch('/:code')` under the existing `router.use(requireAuth, requireStaff('ads'))` guard. Parse failure -> fail(res,'Invalid preview fields',422); success -> ok(res,{message:'Short link updated',link}); ShortLinkNotFoundError -> 404; other Errors (e.g. bad http(s) image) -> 422. try/catch + status codes mirror the POST handler. - web/src/lib/admin.ts: added `updateShortLink(code,{ogImage,ogTitle})` doing api.patch(`/admin/links/${code}`, input). - web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx: added a 'Preview / प्रीव्यू' column (small of l.og_image when set, else '4A Store logo (default)' muted label; l.og_title or a muted em-dash), a per-row '✏️ Edit / संपादित करें' btnGhost button, inline editor row (colSpan=7, pre-filled with the row's og_image/og_title, reusing lbl/inp/btnPrimary/btnGhost/card tokens and bilingual labels) with Save (updateShortLink -> invalidate ['admin-links'] -> success toast -> clear) and Cancel. Empty-state colSpan bumped 6->7. - Tests: extended api-node/src/__tests__/shortlinkOg.test.ts with PURE (DB-free) cases asserting updateCustomShortLink rejects a malformed code and an invalid image URL BEFORE any DB access, and that ShortLinkNotFoundError is a distinct Error. VERIFICATION (all green): `cd api-node && npm run build` clean; `cd api-node && npm test` = 79 passing (74 existing + 5 new), 0 fail; `cd web && npm run build` clean (only the pre-existing chunk>500kB informational note). NOTE for later steps: the api-node build initially failed with stale-Prisma-client errors about a `status` field in admin.ts/catalog.ts (NOT files this feature touched). No schema or DB change was made (no prisma migrate/db push); a rebuild resolved it since the generated client under node_modules/.prisma/client already declared `status`. `npx prisma generate` currently errors on this machine (ENOENT copying query_engine-windows.dll.node from node_modules/prisma/ — the engine lives under node_modules/@prisma/engines/), but generation was not needed. Did not run on the live port.
